items.text: Overall color scheme differs: A uses a white page body with dark grey text, while B uses a near-black page body with warm off-white text.
items.evidence: A body_bg rgb(255,255,255), body_color rgb(88,88,88); B body_bg rgb(15,14,14), body_color rgb(242,236,228)

items.text: Each side uses a different accent hue: A uses a saturated red, B uses a burnt orange.
items.evidence: A top_backgrounds include rgb(232,43,24) (7 elements) and red 'HOME' nav item; B top_backgrounds include rgb(226,104,43) (5 elements) on ann

items.text: A's typography mixes several webfonts: Open Sans, Cabin, Krona One, a script face (Arizonia) and book antiqua. B uses only system-ui, Georgia and Arial.
items.evidence: A fonts: Open Sans 302, Cabin 155, Krona One 66, FontAwesome 5, book antiqua 4, Arizonia 1; B fonts: system-ui 88, Georgia 15, Arial 2

items.text: A's h1 is set in a bold uppercase sans-serif. B's h1 is a larger serif at normal weight in sentence case.
items.evidence: A h1: 60px, weight 700, Cabin, 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA'; B h1: 76px, weight 400, Georgia, 'Modern & Contemporary Art'

items.text: Section headings in A are small and uppercase. B's are large serif headings in sentence case.
items.evidence: A h2 20px/700 'PHOTO\nGALLERY'; B h2 44px/400 'Photo gallery'

items.text: B adds an h3 'Login or register' heading, which A does not have.
items.evidence: B heading_outline includes level 3 'Login or register'; B tag_counts h3: 1

items.text: The forgery-exoneration notice is handled differently. A places it as an uppercase nav item that wraps to a second line. B shows it as an underlined link in a separate orange announcement bar at the top.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 nav row 2: 'F. N. SOUZA EXONERATES SON...'; B_slice_00 orange bar with title-case underlined text

items.text: A's hero is a painting slideshow with an overlay title and 9 circular pagination dots. B's hero is a static dark, abstract painterly background with an eyebrow, headline, subtitle and two CTA buttons.
items.evidence: A_slice_00: 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA' with 9 dots; B_slice_00: 'HISTORY & WORKS' eyebrow, 'Explore the gallery' / 'About the artist' buttons

items.text: B turns the nine slide titles into a horizontal strip of italic serif labels, each with an orange star bullet, placed below the hero.
items.evidence: B_slice_00 strip: '✦ Ciudad En Esapana ✦ Multicoloured Villagescape ... ✦ Last Supper'

items.text: In A's bio section, a small thumbnail with a thin border sits next to centered serif paragraph text with an inline 'Read More' link. In B, a large photo sits beside a left-aligned heading, body text and an orange pill 'Read More' button.
items.evidence: A fnsouza.jpg rect 176×131; B fnsouza.jpg rect 484×275; A_slice_01 centered text; B_slice_00 two-column layout

items.text: A's bio paragraph is in a serif face (book antiqua). B's bio text is in system-ui sans.
items.evidence: A fonts include 'book antiqua' (4); A_slice_01 serif paragraph; B fonts dominated by system-ui

items.text: A shows the gallery as a 3+3 masonry-style grid of large images at their natural size. B shows all six as a single row of equal narrow tall tiles that crop the artwork.
items.evidence: A images e.g. landscape_tb 570×442 at rect 570×442, rows at y=2090 and y=2562; B all six rect 177×340 at y=1370

items.text: B crops the wide landscape image heavily into a portrait tile.
items.evidence: B landscape-tb.jpg natural 570×442 rendered 177×340

items.text: B's gallery tiles and bio photo have slightly rounded corners. A's images are square-cornered.
items.evidence: B bucket_1_7: 25; A bucket_1_7: 0, bucket_0: 520

items.text: A's gallery subtitle is centered under the circular heading. B places its subtitle right-aligned on the same row as the heading.
items.evidence: A_slice_01 centered 'Explore a significant collection...'; B_slice_01 subtitle at the right of 'Photo gallery'

items.text: Image alt text differs: A's images have empty alt attributes, while B's images have descriptive alts.
items.evidence: A images alt ''; B alt 'Landscape', 'Last Supper', 'Mother and child', etc.

items.text: Image filenames use different separators: underscores in A, hyphens in B.
items.evidence: A 'landscape_tb.jpg'; B 'landscape-tb.jpg'

items.text: A's contact form is two columns (Name/Email/Phone on the left, Message on the right) with placeholder text in light-grey fills. B's is a single narrow column with uppercase labels above dark inputs.
items.evidence: A_slice_02 gray rgb(246,246,246) fields with placeholders; B_slice_01 labels 'NAME', 'EMAIL', 'MESSAGE', dark fields

items.text: B uses explicit label elements for its form fields. A relies mostly on placeholders.
items.evidence: B label 6; A label 2

items.text: A's submit button is an outlined, square-cornered, uppercase 'SEND MESSAGE' centered below the form. B's is a filled orange pill 'Send message' aligned left.
items.evidence: A primary_button radius 0px, bg white, padding 17.5px 30px; A_slice_02 vs B_slice_01 orange rounded button

items.text: B's measured primary button is a 'Menu' toggle with a 6px radius, which suggests a menu control for small screens.
items.evidence: B primary_button text 'Menu', radius 6px, padding 8px 12px

items.text: A's footer is solid black with centered '© 2021 | PRIVACY POLICY' in bold uppercase, plus a 'More Art Gallery Templates at TemplateMonster.com' credit. B's footer is a dark bar with '© 2021 Privacy Policy' on the left and 'Login or register' on the right.
items.evidence: A_slice_03; B_slice_01 bottom

items.text: A has a red user-icon login button fixed at the top-right corner. B moves login to a footer link and dialogs.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 red square icon top-right; B 'Login or register' footer link, dialog: 2

items.text: A wraps slides and gallery items in article and figure elements. B has none of these and uses section elements and a footer instead.
items.evidence: A article 6, figure 6, footer 0; B article 0, figure 0, section 3, footer 1

items.text: Layout mechanisms differ: B uses CSS grid and flex. A uses almost no flex and no grid.
items.evidence: B display_grid 10, display_flex 8; A display_grid 0, display_flex 1

items.text: B has one box shadow, which is visible under the bio photo. A has no shadows.
items.evidence: B box_shadows 1; A box_shadows 0

items.text: Body text metrics differ slightly.
items.evidence: A body 16px/30px line-height; B 17px/28.05px

items.text: A uses an icon font. B uses no icon font and relies on text glyphs (✦, ▾).
items.evidence: A FontAwesome 5 elements, i tags 3; B no icon font, star glyphs in the strip

items.text: B's meta tags include charset and viewport. A's include content-type and generator.
items.evidence: A meta_names content-type, description, generator; B charset, viewport, description

items.text: Word counts differ. B adds copy A lacks, such as the hero subtitle 'The works and legacy of Francis Newton Souza, India's mystical expressionist.'
items.evidence: A words 227, emoji 1; B words 160, emoji 0; B_slice_00 subtitle

items.text: B uses a secondary muted taupe text color for subtitles and labels.
items.evidence: B top_text_colors rgb(167,158,148) on 37 elements

items.text: B separates sections with alternating dark tones and thin horizontal rules. A separates sections with white space on a white background.
items.evidence: B backgrounds rgb(15,14,14) and rgb(24,22,22); B_slice_01 divider lines; A_slice_01/02 white gaps

items.text: A's header is a full-width painting slider with a centered, uppercase wide-display logotype and a script 'History & Works' tagline. B's header is a compact dark bar with a small serif wordmark on the left and the nav on the right.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 top: centered Krona One-style title over the painting; B_slice_00: left-aligned two-line serif name and right-aligned nav in a da

items.text: B uses more ARIA attributes and more button elements.
items.evidence: B aria_attrs 8, buttons 8; A aria_attrs 3, buttons 2

items.text: A's hero text is overlaid directly on a busy painting: the slide title is white and left-aligned at mid-height. B's hero copy sits in a left-aligned column over a darkened image, with a subtitle paragraph and a CTA pair.
items.evidence: A slice 0 title 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA' at y≈620; B slice 0 headline, subtitle and buttons stacked at left

items.text: DOM weight differs greatly: A has 196 divs, 187 spans, 29 scripts, 24 links, 21 stylesheets and 60 inline style attributes. B has 17 divs, 1 span, 1 script, 0 stylesheets and 9 inline style attributes.
items.evidence: A tag_counts div 196, span 187, script 29; counts stylesheets 21; B div 17, span 1, script 1, stylesheets 0

items.text: Class usage: A has 1104 class tokens across 221 unique classes (template framework style). B has only 34 class tokens with 21 unique, with a single inline style block.
items.evidence: A classes total 1104 unique 221; B classes total 34 unique 21; B style 1

items.text: Page length and density: A's page is 4120px tall; B's is 2567px. A's vertical rhythm includes large white gaps between sections, while B is more compact.
items.evidence: layout.page_height A 4120, B 2567

items.text: A includes a template credit ('More Art Gallery Templates at TemplateMonster.com') and the slider h1s contain the typo 'ESAPANA'; B keeps the typo ('Ciudad En Esapana') in its category list but drops the template credit.
items.evidence: A slice 3 credit; heading_outline 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA'; B slice 0 'Ciudad En Esapana'

items.text: A's overall content width is about 1170px (gallery spans x≈135–1305) with centered section headings. B uses a ~1120px container (x=160–1280) with left-aligned headings and content.
items.evidence: A image rects x135 to 1305; B image rects x160 to 1280, h1 text_align start

items.text: The hero image in B is not among the page's listed img elements (an 8th img has no file and 0x0 size), while the hero in A is a visible slider image behind the header.
items.evidence: B_facts images[7] file '' natural 0x0 rect 0x0; A hero painting visible in slice 0

features.statement: Page uses a near-black background with warm off-white body text, giving a dark-mode overall color scheme.
A single burnt-orange accent color is used for buttons, announcement bar and bullets.
Secondary text such as subtitles and labels uses a muted taupe tone.
Typography relies on system fonts and Georgia serif only, with no custom webfonts.
Headings are large, normal-weight serifs in sentence case rather than bold uppercase sans-serif.
Body paragraphs use a system sans-serif face, contrasting with serif headings.
Small uppercase eyebrow and form labels accompany headings and fields.
A thin announcement bar at the top carries an underlined title-case link in the accent color.
Hero is a static darkened painterly background with eyebrow, headline, subtitle and two call-to-action buttons in a left-aligned column.
A horizontal strip of italic serif labels with decorative star glyph bullets sits below the hero.
Buttons are filled accent-colored pills, including the primary Read More and form submit buttons.
Content sections use two-column layouts with a large image beside left-aligned heading and text.
Gallery is a single row of equal narrow tall tiles that crop images heavily.
Images have slightly rounded corners and a subtle shadow under featured photo.
Section header places a right-aligned subtitle on the same row as left-aligned heading.
Images carry descriptive alt text.
Contact form is a single narrow column with visible labels above dark input fields.
Header is a compact dark bar with small serif wordmark at left and navigation at right.
Footer is a dark bar with copyright and privacy link at left and login link at right.
Sections are separated by alternating dark tones and thin horizontal divider rules.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox in a compact, shorter page with a ~1120px container.
Markup is lean and semantic, with section and footer elements, few divs, few classes, and no stylesheets or heavy scripts.
Interactive elements use more buttons and ARIA attributes, including dialogs and a menu toggle.
Copy adds a concise descriptive hero subtitle and uses sentence-case microcopy such as 'Send message'.
